framework: Autonomous-readiness criteria for SDL instrument interfaces

item.name: NIMO
item.organisation: National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS), Center for Basic Research on Materials
item.notes: Device integration provided by the NIMO Controller; MCP connects a language-model agent to the NIMO decision engine and to laboratory devices. MCP is a governed model-facing tool protocol with JSON Schema typing, but without a shared laboratory-device vocabulary.
